## Professional Summary

Ph.D. in Applied Mathematics with extensive expertise in mathematical modeling, numerical analysis, high-performance scientific computing, and machine learning. Proven track record in designing advanced computational solvers and open-source libraries ([`PyOdys`](https://github.com/itchinda/pyodys-project) and [`CFEM++`](https://github.com/itchinda/cfempp)) in Python and C++. Adept at bridging complex theoretical frameworks with scalable data-driven solutions, deep learning applications, and numerical optimization for scientific and industrial problems.

## Education

* **Ph.D. in Applied Mathematics** | Université Laval, Canada (2019 – 2024)
  * *Focus:* Numerical Analysis, Finite Element Methods (CutFEM), Multiphysics Modeling.
* **Master 1 in Mechanics (Mathematical Methods for Mechanics)** | Université Paris-Saclay, France (2017 – 2018)
* **Master of Science (M.Sc.) in Mathematics** | AIMS Senegal (2016 – 2017)
* **Bachelor of Science & Master 1 in Physics** | University of Douala, Cameroon (2011 – 2015)

## Technical Skills & Expertise

* **Programming & Libraries:** Python (NumPy, PyTorch, SciPy, Pandas), C/C++ (High-Performance Computing), MATLAB, Git, Linux/Unix environments.
* **AI, Data Science & Machine Learning:** Deep Neural Networks, Recurrent Neural Networks (LSTM/GRU), Time-Series Forecasting, Model Predictive Control (MPC), Numerical Optimization (L-BFGS-B).
* **Scientific Computing & Numerical Methods:** Partial Differential Equations (PDEs), Ordinary Differential Equations (ODEs), Finite Element Methods (FEM, CutFEM), Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD).
* **Languages:** French (Native/Bilingual), English (Professional Proficiency).

## Research, R&D & Software Engineering Experience

* **Postdoctoral Researcher (Multiphysics R&D)** | GIREF, Université Laval (2024 – 2025)
  * Researched advanced mathematical modeling and numerical simulation for complex multiphysics fluid flows (coextrusion processes).
  * Authored scientific research papers detailing high-accuracy numerical algorithms.
* **Lead Developer** | [`CFEM++`](https://github.com/itchinda/cfempp) C++ Scientific Computing Library (Ongoing)
  * Architecting a high-performance C++ finite element framework tailored for moving interface problems and complex fluid simulations.
  * Optimized core numerical solvers and data structures for maximum computational efficiency.
* **Creator & Maintainer** | [`PyOdys`](https://github.com/itchinda/pyodys-project) Open-Source Python Package (2024 – Present)
  * Designed and released a modular Python solver package for Ordinary Differential Equations (ODEs) utilizing advanced Runge-Kutta and linear multistep integration schemes.
* **Ph.D. Research Developer** | GIREF, Université Laval (2019 – 2024)
  * Developed and integrated custom C++ finite element solvers (CutFEM) within the [`MEF++`](https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/MEF%2B%2B) simulation software environment for phase-change phenomena.
  * Validated complex numerical models, resulting in multiple publications in peer-reviewed international scientific journals.
